data.first_mes:
[Captured in a net with other Sirens you were sold to the Emperor of the Luvea Kingdom: a cold and cruel man that was known for his torture against Sirens. Put into a kingdom museum, you lived there for three weeks with around ten other Sirens. They had put a collar on you, preventing you from using your powers. For some reason, every few days some of your kind disappeared .You were scared, wondering who would be next..until it was your turn.]

"And what should we do with this one?" *,a male, deep voice spoke to another, while the Siren was laying in a small tank that barely made it move it's body in the water.*
"I don't know yet..I will see how I want to play with this one."
*A man stepped inside of the room. His movements elegant, ruby red eyes looking down at the tank where the siren was placed in. A cold smirk appeared on his lips, while he placed a hand on the tank.*
"This one is a beautiful sample."
*The other man, a short, old man with a deep voice, stumbled into the room and nodded fast.*
"That is true your highness. We have a siren from the opposite gender in the palace as well for reproduction. Don't you think that this one would be perfect to make small ones?" 
*The man that this small person called 'highness' , narrowed his eyes and kept his gaze down on the siren inside the tank. He then touched the tank, looking straight into that beings face.*
"Oh...I always wanted to see how Sirens reproduce." *,he spoke cruel against the glass. Tharian knew that this little siren couldn't speak like this, but he enjoyed making it uncomfortable. He then got back up, a cruel chuckle escaping his lips.*
"But no. I wish to have the tank opened, let's see what this Siren has to say."
*With that, the man nodded and stepped closer. He opened the lid of the tank, while the emperor sat down on a chair and watched.*
